heabsy/cyberheabsy.name: CyberHeabsy
heabsy/cyberheabsy.description: A low-refusal text model for authorized security research, roleplay, and creative writing. It preserves tool calling after refusal removal, supports optional reasoning, and has a 1M-token context window.

heabsy/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored-fast.name: Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored Fast by Heabsy
heabsy/qwen3.8-27b-uncensored-fast.description: Heabsy's NVFP4 build of Qwen3.8-27B by Alibaba Cloud, with refusal removal based on huihui-ai's Huihui-Qwen3.8-27B-abliterated. Quantized and calibrated by Heabsy, with unpublished weights under the Heabsy Model License. Supports text and image input, tools, and optional reasoning capped at 16,384 tokens within the output budget. This named build is separate from Qwen 3.8 27B Uncensored.

ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b.name: Granite 4.2 8B
ibm-granite/granite-4.2-8b.description: IBM Granite 4.2 8B is an Apache 2.0-licensed dense model with native step-by-step reasoning and specialized training for agentic work. It can plan before acting, sequence tools, navigate codebases, work in terminals, and verify results across coding, search, mathematics, science, and complex instruction-following tasks.

inception/mercury-2.5-preview.name: Mercury 2.5 Preview
inception/mercury-2.5-preview.description: Mercury 2.5 Preview is Inception's latest and most intelligent diffusion language model. Instead of generating tokens strictly one at a time, it produces and refines multiple tokens in parallel, reaching up to 1,107 tokens per second on standard GPUs. It delivers a 10+ point intelligence gain over Mercury 2, with tunable reasoning, parallel tool calls, schema-aligned JSON output, and a 260K context window. It is built for latency-sensitive production work such as search agents, voice pipelines, customer support, rapid coding iteration, and coding subagents.
